examples.example_question: What are the ids, version numbers, and type codes for each template?
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_template_id ?t1_version_number ?t1_template_type_code where { ?t1 a :templates . ?t1 :templates\#template_id ?t1_template_id . ?t1 :templates\#version_number ?t1_version_number . ?t1 :templates\#template_type_code ?t1_template_type_code .        }

examples.example_question: How many car models were produced by the maker with full name American Motor Company?
examples.example_gold_query: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) where { ?t1 a :model_list . ?t2 a :car_makers . ?t1 :model_list\#ref-maker ?t2 .  ?t2 :car_makers\#fullname ?t2_fullname . FILTER(?t2_fullname = 'American Motor Company') .        }

examples.example_question: What are the id, role, and first name of the professionals who have performed two or more treatments?
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name where { ?t1 a :professionals . ?t2 a :treatments . ?t2 :treatments\#ref-professional_id ?t1 .  ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id . ?t1 :professionals\#role_code ?t1_role_code . ?t1 :professionals\#first_name ?t1_first_name . ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id .        } group by ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name   having(count( *)  >= 2)

examples.example_question: Find the model of the car whose weight is below the average weight.
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_model where { ?t1 a :car_names . ?t2 a :cars_data . ?t2 :cars_data\#ref-id ?t1 .  ?t1 :car_names\#model ?t1_model . ?t2 :cars_data\#weight ?t2_weight . FILTER(?t2_weight < ?aggregation_t23_weight_100) .       {select (avg( ?t23_weight) as ?aggregation_t23_weight_100 ) where { ?t23 a :cars_data . ?t23 :cars_data\#weight ?t23_weight .        }    } }

examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_template_id ?t1_version_number ?t1_template_type_code where { ?t1 a :templates . ?t1 :templates\#template_id ?t1_template_id . ?t1 :templates\#version_number ?t1_version_number . ?t1 :templates\#template_type_code ?t1_template_type_code .        }

examples.example_question: How many car models were produced by the maker with full name American Motor Company?
examples.example_gold_query: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) where { ?t1 a :model_list . ?t2 a :car_makers . ?t1 :model_list\#ref-maker ?t2 .  ?t2 :car_makers\#fullname ?t2_fullname . FILTER(?t2_fullname = 'American Motor Company') .        }

examples.example_question: What are the id, role, and first name of the professionals who have performed two or more treatments?
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name where { ?t1 a :professionals . ?t2 a :treatments . ?t2 :treatments\#ref-professional_id ?t1 .  ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id . ?t1 :professionals\#role_code ?t1_role_code . ?t1 :professionals\#first_name ?t1_first_name . ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id .        } group by ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name   having(count( *)  >= 2)

examples.example_question: Find the model of the car whose weight is below the average weight.
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_model where { ?t1 a :car_names . ?t2 a :cars_data . ?t2 :cars_data\#ref-id ?t1 .  ?t1 :car_names\#model ?t1_model . ?t2 :cars_data\#weight ?t2_weight . FILTER(?t2_weight < ?aggregation_t23_weight_100) .       {select (avg( ?t23_weight) as ?aggregation_t23_weight_100 ) where { ?t23 a :cars_data . ?t23 :cars_data\#weight ?t23_weight .        }    } }

examples.example_question: What are the ids, version numbers, and type codes for each template?
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_template_id ?t1_version_number ?t1_template_type_code where { ?t1 a :templates . ?t1 :templates\#template_id ?t1_template_id . ?t1 :templates\#version_number ?t1_version_number . ?t1 :templates\#template_type_code ?t1_template_type_code .        }

examples.example_question: How many car models were produced by the maker with full name American Motor Company?
examples.example_gold_query: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) where { ?t1 a :model_list . ?t2 a :car_makers . ?t1 :model_list\#ref-maker ?t2 .  ?t2 :car_makers\#fullname ?t2_fullname . FILTER(?t2_fullname = 'American Motor Company') .        }

examples.example_question: What are the id, role, and first name of the professionals who have performed two or more treatments?
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name where { ?t1 a :professionals . ?t2 a :treatments . ?t2 :treatments\#ref-professional_id ?t1 .  ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id . ?t1 :professionals\#role_code ?t1_role_code . ?t1 :professionals\#first_name ?t1_first_name . ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id .        } group by ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name   having(count( *)  >= 2)

examples.example_question: Find the model of the car whose weight is below the average weight.
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_model where { ?t1 a :car_names . ?t2 a :cars_data . ?t2 :cars_data\#ref-id ?t1 .  ?t1 :car_names\#model ?t1_model . ?t2 :cars_data\#weight ?t2_weight . FILTER(?t2_weight < ?aggregation_t23_weight_100) .       {select (avg( ?t23_weight) as ?aggregation_t23_weight_100 ) where { ?t23 a :cars_data . ?t23 :cars_data\#weight ?t23_weight .        }    } }

examples.example_question: What are the ids, version numbers, and type codes for each template?
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_template_id ?t1_version_number ?t1_template_type_code where { ?t1 a :templates . ?t1 :templates\#template_id ?t1_template_id . ?t1 :templates\#version_number ?t1_version_number . ?t1 :templates\#template_type_code ?t1_template_type_code .        }

examples.example_question: How many car models were produced by the maker with full name American Motor Company?
examples.example_gold_query: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) where { ?t1 a :model_list . ?t2 a :car_makers . ?t1 :model_list\#ref-maker ?t2 .  ?t2 :car_makers\#fullname ?t2_fullname . FILTER(?t2_fullname = 'American Motor Company') .        }

examples.example_question: What are the id, role, and first name of the professionals who have performed two or more treatments?
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name where { ?t1 a :professionals . ?t2 a :treatments . ?t2 :treatments\#ref-professional_id ?t1 .  ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id . ?t1 :professionals\#role_code ?t1_role_code . ?t1 :professionals\#first_name ?t1_first_name . ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id .        } group by ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name   having(count( *)  >= 2)

examples.example_question: Find the model of the car whose weight is below the average weight.
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_model where { ?t1 a :car_names . ?t2 a :cars_data . ?t2 :cars_data\#ref-id ?t1 .  ?t1 :car_names\#model ?t1_model . ?t2 :cars_data\#weight ?t2_weight . FILTER(?t2_weight < ?aggregation_t23_weight_100) .       {select (avg( ?t23_weight) as ?aggregation_t23_weight_100 ) where { ?t23 a :cars_data . ?t23 :cars_data\#weight ?t23_weight .        }    } }

examples.example_question: How many car models were produced by the maker with full name American Motor Company?

examples.example_question: What are the id, role, and first name of the professionals who have performed two or more treatments?

examples.example_question: How many car models were produced by the maker with full name American Motor Company?
examples.example_gold_query: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) where { ?t1 a :model_list . ?t2 a :car_makers . ?t1 :model_list\#ref-maker ?t2 .  ?t2 :car_makers\#fullname ?t2_fullname . FILTER(?t2_fullname = 'American Motor Company') .        }

examples.example_question: What are the id, role, and first name of the professionals who have performed two or more treatments?

examples.example_question: What are the ids, version numbers, and type codes for each template?
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_template_id ?t1_version_number ?t1_template_type_code where { ?t1 a :templates . ?t1 :templates\#template_id ?t1_template_id . ?t1 :templates\#version_number ?t1_version_number . ?t1 :templates\#template_type_code ?t1_template_type_code .        }

examples.example_question: How many car models were produced by the maker with full name American Motor Company?
examples.example_gold_query: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) where { ?t1 a :model_list . ?t2 a :car_makers . ?t1 :model_list\#ref-maker ?t2 .  ?t2 :car_makers\#fullname ?t2_fullname . FILTER(?t2_fullname = 'American Motor Company') .        }

examples.example_question: What are the id, role, and first name of the professionals who have performed two or more treatments?
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name where { ?t1 a :professionals . ?t2 a :treatments . ?t2 :treatments\#ref-professional_id ?t1 .  ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id . ?t1 :professionals\#role_code ?t1_role_code . ?t1 :professionals\#first_name ?t1_first_name . ?t1 :professionals\#professional_id ?t1_professional_id .        } group by ?t1_professional_id ?t1_role_code ?t1_first_name   having(count( *)  >= 2)

examples.example_question: Find the model of the car whose weight is below the average weight.
examples.example_gold_query: select ?t1_model where { ?t1 a :car_names . ?t2 a :cars_data . ?t2 :cars_data\#ref-id ?t1 .  ?t1 :car_names\#model ?t1_model . ?t2 :cars_data\#weight ?t2_weight . FILTER(?t2_weight < ?aggregation_t23_weight_100) .       {select (avg( ?t23_weight) as ?aggregation_t23_weight_100 ) where { ?t23 a :cars_data . ?t23 :cars_data\#weight ?t23_weight .        }    } }
